_comment: Concrete Fabric Activator rule definitions for the gateway monitor. Label: [NET-NEW] / [Unverified]. The Activator rule DSL/config surface is not fully public; these are reference definitions to be recreated in the Activator UI and CONFIRMED in-tenant (Phase 5 item U6). Field names are illustrative of intent, not a guaranteed import format.
_guardrails: Circuit breaker: if the same remediation fires >3x in 30 min for the same gateway, suppress + escalate to human. Destructive actions require Tier-2 human-in-loop approval (Teams Adaptive Card).

rules.name: gateway-offline
rules.transition: fires on state change to offline (stateful, not every poll)

action.message: Gateway {GatewayObjectId} offline: no heartbeat for {heartbeat_age_minutes}m. Affected datasets: {blast_radius}.

rules.name: spool-disk-forecast-low
rules.transition: fires when 2h forecast crosses floor (proactive, before exhaustion)

action.message: Gateway {GatewayHostName} spool disk forecast to hit {min_forecast_free_gb}GB within 2h.

action.approval: Teams Adaptive Card (Approve/Deny), 15-min timeout -> defer + ticket

action.message: Datasource {datasourceName} on {GatewayObjectId} status={datasource_status}. Likely credential/OAuth expiry.

action.note: Enrich with diffpatterns top-offender + LLM RCA hypothesis (v4), then notify.

action.message: Gateway {GatewayObjectId} CPU anomaly (score {anomaly_score}) vs seasonal baseline.

rules.name: mashup-container-runaway
rules.condition: peak_working_set_mb > 6000  // MB; tune per host RAM
rules.transition: fires when a mashup container's working set crosses the runaway threshold

action.message: Runaway mashup container on {HostName} ({GatewayObjectId}): peak {peak_working_set_mb}MB across {distinct_processes} processes.
